change.purpose: Operator request 2026-10-06: '* varm återupptagning som v1.9.0, påslaget som standard. * fixa UI så att refresh av controller inte "nollställer" en kryssruta som man just klickat i, dropdowns ska inte resettas etc. UI är omöjlig att använda i vissa fall då refresh ändrar på aktiva focus kontroller. * Aktivera Arbetsläge ska vara ikryssat och aktivt vid uppstart.'

before.warmResume: Every queue activation of a parked GFW opened a fresh ChatGPT chat and sent a FULL prompt (SESSION_ROTATION, sessionSeq+1). Diagnostics 2026-10-05 (derived facts): FULL prompts were 94 % of all input tokens; 58-88 new chats were opened per day.
before.panel: sidepanel.js re-rendered every 5 s, on every chrome.storage change and on every EIC_GF_SNAPSHOT_CHANGED broadcast; each render wrote stored values into the settings controls, rebuilt the queue rows (missionQueueList.innerHTML) and the saved-mission/queue-set dropdown options, and the broadcast handler cleared an unsent instruction draft. Reproduced in Chromium: tools/verify-panel-edit-guard.mjs on v1.8.14 3/12.
before.workMode: workModeEnabled was only ever set by 'Spara Arbetsläge'; nothing turned it on at startup. A stored workModeSupervisorWorkerId that no longer existed (window closed, worker not restored after a browser restart) left every worker at NOT_SUPERVISOR, so Arbetsläge was on but idle; an empty supervisor let every worker poll. Reproduced: tests/v190-work-mode-startup.test.mjs on v1.8.14.

design.warmResume: lib/warm-resume.mjs (pure). warmResumeDecision at queue activation: warm only when the parked snapshot is ANALYZING with captured response and prompt hashes, the park outcome is an ordinary queue boundary (WARM_RESUME_PARK_OUTCOMES), the resume source is a completed response, the last answer did not ask ROTATE_SESSION_NOW, the conversation is known and consistent and not used by another GFW, the conversation has fewer than 10 Greenfield prompts and idle <= 24 h. Warm: sessionSeq unchanged, CONTINUATION with warmResumeObjective, the tab navigates to the GFW's conversation and the existing v1.7.7 selectPromptProfile decides COMPACT or FULL. warmResumePageVerdict before SENDING: conversation shown (15 s redirect grace), thread loaded, not generating, composer ready and empty, last user turn is the GFW's own prompt, all within 90 s, plus the existing EIC surface proof. Any ABANDON rebuilds the unchanged cold FULL SESSION_ROTATION prompt (sessionSeq+1) and opens a fresh chat; nothing is sent in the old conversation. Setting warmQueueResume (default true) in operator settings and the panel.
design.panel: lib/panel-edit-guard.mjs (DOM-only). guardedSet: a control keeps the operator's value while it has focus or differs from the value the panel last rendered into it; such a control is marked gf-unsaved; equal values release it; releaseControl after a successful save, forceSet for an explicit reset. guardedHtml: a rebuilt container (queue rows, cleanup list, dropdown options) is not rebuilt when its markup is unchanged, while a field inside has focus or while a change from it is pending (beginPending); after a committed queue-row change the row is rebuilt at once and focus returns to the same field. The broadcast no longer clears the instruction draft.
design.workMode: lib/work-mode-supervisor.mjs (pure). runtime.onStartup and runtime.onInstalled call enableWorkModeAtStartup (workModeEnabled=true with readback, incident WORK_MODE_ENABLED_AT_STARTUP); a service-worker wake does not. syncWorkModeForWorker: one live worker polls; a supervisor without a running process bound to an open window is replaced by the ticking worker (stored with readback, audit + incident WORK_MODE_SUPERVISOR_CLAIMED); a live reserved worker (v1.8.12) is preferred when the role is taken over. The normalised default of workModeEnabled is unchanged (false) so that no test harness polls the network; the start hooks turn it on.

environment.kind: local Node harness with real background.js and mocked Chrome APIs (fetch stubbed locally in the work-mode tests); Chromium via Playwright with the real sidepanel.html/sidepanel.js and a stubbed background for panel tools

baseline.command: npm test (v1.8.14, commit 870408c, re-run for this release)

reproductionBeforeChange.command: the three v1.9.0 test files and tools/verify-panel-edit-guard.mjs (GF_PANEL_ROOT) against the v1.8.14 tree; pure modules copied in, not wired
reproductionBeforeChange.result: warm resume 2/10 (only the pure policy tests pass), panel edit guard 6/7 (module tests pass, panel test fails), work mode 2/7 (pure decision + 'switched off' pass); Chromium panel 3/12

claimBoundary.liveChatGPTWarmResume: UNVERIFIED (long-thread loading, model picker state of a reopened chat and ChatGPT's behaviour on a deleted chat are exercised only with synthetic pages)
claimBoundary.tokenSaving: NOT_MEASURED live (in the harness the warm COMPACT prompt was under half of the cold FULL prompt; the 2026-10-05 figures describe the state before the change)
claimBoundary.panel: verified in Chromium with the real panel code and a stubbed background; not in the installed extension
claimBoundary.packageIntegrity: INTEGRITY.json binds packaged bytes; not a code-correctness proof

knownRemainingRisks: Warm resume keeps a GFW in one conversation for up to 9 Greenfield prompts; very long threads may load slowly in ChatGPT (the 90 s page check then falls back to a fresh chat with FULL)
A reopened conversation is sent to only after the existing EIC surface/model proof; if ChatGPT shows a different model in an older chat, the existing model hold applies as before
While the cursor is in a queue-row field the queue list does not refresh; it refreshes when the cursor leaves

Arbetsläge is turned on at every Chrome start and extension reload, including after the operator switched it off in the previous session; this is the requested behaviour and is stated in UPPDATERA_TILL_1_9_0.md
Work-mode tasks are still polled only during a running GFW's tick; with no running GFW nothing is fetched although Arbetsläge is on
Everything listed for 1.8.14 (Hjalmar not consulted at a queue boundary) still applies
